newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Ciputra Devt sees 1996 net 130.6 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Ciputra Devt sees 1996 net 130.6 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian property firm Ciputra Development said on Monday its net profit was expected to be around 130.6 billion rupiah in 1996, compared with 93.1 billion in 1995.
PT Ciputra Development director Harun Hajadi told reporters after a briefing for analysts that the company expected sales to remain strong this year.
"Sales this year are expected to reach 720 billion rupiah," he said. "We expect the net income to rise to 163.3 billion in 1997."
"We expect 1999 net profit to be around 250 billion rupiah on sales of about 1.0 trillion rupiah," he added. He gave no figures for 1998.
